These services involve physical manufacturing, engineering expertise, and support for both internal and external customers in the energy sector.

products.name: Drilling Automation and Technology Solutions
products.description: Development, commercialization, and deployment of digital automation technologies and software designed to improve drilling efficiency, accuracy, and wellbore quality. These solutions are delivered digitally and integrated with the company's rig fleet, enabling data-driven, machine-human collaboration and remote operations support.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of commercial real estate properties, including a shopping center and undeveloped land in Tulsa, Oklahoma, to external tenants. This business line involves property management and leasing activities.

products.name: Diagnostic Imaging Services
products.description: Comprehensive outpatient and joint-venture hospital-based diagnostic imaging services, including MRI, CT, PET, nuclear medicine, mammography, ultrasound, X-ray, fluoroscopy, and related procedures. Services are delivered via fixed-site imaging centers using advanced imaging equipment and are provided to patients referred by physicians or payors.

products.name: Digital Health Informatics Solutions
products.description: Development and sale of digital health software platforms for radiology, including RIS, PACS, image storage/retrieval, and workflow management systems. These are delivered as cloud-native or on-premise solutions to outpatient radiology centers and hospital systems, supporting scheduling, image management, and operational workflows.

products.name: AI-Enabled Clinical Imaging Solutions
products.description: AI-powered software suites for radiology, including tools for scan interpretation (e.g., breast, lung, prostate), workflow orchestration, and population health. Delivered as standalone or integrated modules, these solutions enhance diagnostic quality and operational efficiency for healthcare providers globally.

products.name: Teleradiology Services
products.description: Remote interpretation of diagnostic images for healthcare providers, primarily within the UK National Health Service, using digital transmission and radiologist expertise. Services are delivered via a majority-owned international subsidiary and support providers lacking on-site radiology resources.

products.name: Image Exchange Platform Services
products.description: Cloud-based platforms for secure exchange and sharing of medical images among hospitals and healthcare providers, enabling screening programs and collaboration. Delivered through acquired subsidiaries, these services support both NHS and private providers, with embedded AI capabilities.

products.name: Innovative Therapeutic Candidates
products.description: Novel drug and biologic therapies for diseases with significant unmet medical need, developed through in-licensing, acquisition, and internal R&D. These products require extensive preclinical and clinical development, regulatory approval, and manufacturing under cGMP standards before commercialization.

products.name: Farmland Leasing
products.description: Leasing of high-quality farmland to farm operators under fixed or variable rent agreements. The company owns and manages farmland, primarily in the U.S., and leases it to tenants who conduct farming operations. This is a physical asset-based business requiring real estate acquisition, management, and tenant relationships.

products.name: Agriculture Equipment Dealership Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of land and buildings for agriculture equipment dealerships to third-party operators. The company owns real estate used by branded equipment dealerships and leases these properties to external tenants. This involves physical real estate assets and long-term lease agreements.

products.name: Farmland-Backed Lending (FPI Loan Program)
products.description: Provision of loans to landowners and farmers, secured by farmland, crops, equipment, or other collateral. The company offers financing for business operations, property acquisitions, working capital, and farming infrastructure. This is a financial service leveraging the company's agricultural expertise and capital.

products.name: Direct Farming Operations
products.description: Direct operation of farms, primarily permanent crop farmland, through a taxable REIT subsidiary. The company manages and operates certain farms itself, involving in-person agricultural labor and management of crop production.

products.name: Renewable Energy Leasing (Solar and Wind)
products.description: Leasing of farmland for solar and wind energy production projects. The company enters into long-term lease arrangements with operators who install and operate renewable energy infrastructure on its properties. This involves physical land assets and regulated energy infrastructure.

products.name: Senior Housing Communities (Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care)
products.description: Residential communities providing independent living, assisted living, and memory care services to seniors, including housing, meals, housekeeping, transportation, social activities, and personalized care. These are physically operated facilities with on-site staff and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Skilled Nursing Facilities
products.description: Licensed healthcare facilities providing rehabilitative and nursing care, including ancillary therapies, to residents requiring more intensive medical attention than assisted living. These facilities are highly regulated and require licensed medical staff.

products.name: Respite and Temporary Care Programs
products.description: Short-term residential care programs offering transitional apartments and full access to community amenities and services for seniors not ready to return home after hospital or rehabilitation stays. Delivered through physical facilities with in-person staff.

products.name: Therapy and Wellness Programs
products.description: On-site preventive and restorative therapy services, including physical, occupational, and other specialized therapies, provided through partnerships with third-party providers at senior living communities.

products.name: Management Services for Senior Housing Communities
products.description: Third-party management of senior housing communities, providing operational oversight, staffing, and administration in exchange for management fees. Delivered through management contracts with property owners.

products.name: Retail Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of space in neighborhood and community shopping centers, primarily anchored by grocery stores, to necessity, service, convenience, and value-based retailers. This involves owning, operating, and managing physical retail properties and providing tenants with access to high-traffic suburban locations.

products.name: Retail Real Estate Development and Redevelopment Services
products.description: Development and redevelopment of retail shopping centers, including ground-up construction and significant renovations to enhance property value and tenant mix. These services require physical construction, capital investment, and project management expertise.

products.name: Global Capability Center (GCC) Set-Up and Operation
products.description: End-to-end turnkey solutions for designing, building, and operating Global Capability Centers (GCCs) as extensions of client organizations, including location strategy, talent acquisition, infrastructure enablement, regulatory compliance, and ongoing management. Delivered through both Aeries-owned and client-owned models, often in cost-effective global locations.

products.name: GCC Optimization and Transformation Services
products.description: Modular services to optimize, transform, or expand existing GCCs, including process improvement, operational excellence programs, function takeovers, building new functions or Centers of Excellence, and shared services setup. Delivered through flexible commercial models and tailored to client needs.

products.name: GCC Advisory and Consulting Services
products.description: Strategic advisory and consulting for the full lifecycle of GCCs, including business case creation, feasibility analysis, operating model design, compliance, technology stack planning, and change management. Services are delivered as fixed-fee engagements with optional execution support.

products.name: AI-Powered Digital Transformation Services
products.description: Integrated digital transformation services leveraging AI, automation, and data intelligence to optimize enterprise functions, automate processes, and drive innovation. Includes AI strategy, intelligent automation (RPA, IDP), predictive analytics, process optimization, and change management.

products.name: Business Function Managed Services (Technology, Finance, HR, IT, Customer Service, Cybersecurity)
products.description: Managed services and expert-led consulting to operate and optimize core business functions for clients, including technology, finance & accounting, business applications, IT infrastructure, customer service delivery, and cybersecurity. Delivered via remote teams embedded within client organizations through GCCs.

products.name: Talent Acquisition and Augmentation Services
products.description: Recruitment, deployment, and management of talent for client operations, including talent acquisition, workforce planning, talent augmentation, and rebadging services. Aeries hires and manages personnel as extensions of client teams, providing flexibility and cost efficiency.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Servicing
products.description: Comprehensive servicing of residential forward and reverse mortgage loans, including collection of payments, escrow administration, loss mitigation, foreclosure management, and REO disposition, delivered through both owned and subservicing arrangements for institutional clients and investors. Requires regulated infrastructure, significant human labor, and technology systems.

products.name: Reverse Mortgage Servicing
products.description: Servicing of reverse mortgage loans, including borrower funding, loan repurchase and assignment to HUD, and securitization of loan tails, provided to institutional clients and investors. Involves regulated processes, specialized compliance, and technology systems.

products.name: Commercial Mortgage Servicing
products.description: Servicing of small balance commercial mortgage loans, including primary and special servicing functions, for institutional clients. Requires specialized regulatory compliance and operational expertise.

products.name: Mortgage Loan Originations
products.description: Origination and purchase of residential forward and reverse mortgage loans through retail, wholesale, and correspondent channels, with prompt sale or securitization in the secondary market. Involves regulated lending, underwriting, and fulfillment operations.

products.name: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR) Acquisition and Sales
products.description: Acquisition and sale of mortgage servicing rights through bulk purchases, flow purchase agreements, and participation in Agency Cash Window/co-issue programs, serving institutional investors and counterparties. Requires financial capital and expertise in MSR valuation and transactions.

products.name: Subservicing and Special Servicing
products.description: Provision of subservicing and special servicing for mortgage portfolios owned by third parties, including management of performing and delinquent loans, loss mitigation, and compliance activities. Delivered to institutional clients and MSR investors, leveraging operational scale and technology.

products.name: CAVA Restaurants (Fast-Casual Mediterranean Food)
products.description: Operates fast-casual restaurants offering chef-curated and customizable Mediterranean bowls and pitas, produced and served in physical restaurant locations with options for in-restaurant dining, digital pick-up, drive-thru, and delivery.

products.name: Packaged Dips, Spreads, and Dressings (CPG)
products.description: Manufactures and sells Mediterranean-inspired dips, spreads, and prepared dressings through grocery stores, produced in company-owned facilities and distributed via retail channels.

products.name: Catering Services
products.description: Provides catering of Mediterranean food offerings for events and groups in select markets, leveraging restaurant and digital infrastructure for order fulfillment and delivery.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides a broad range of financial products and services to businesses and municipalities, including commercial loans, business banking loans, deposit accounts, and treasury management, delivered through physical branches and digital channels.

products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: Offers deposit accounts (checking, savings, MMDA, CDs), consumer loans, home equity loans, and mortgages to individual customers, delivered via branch network, ATMs, and digital platforms.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provides investment management, trust administration, and financial planning services to individuals and institutions, delivered through in-person advisors and digital tools.

products.name: Retirement Plan Administration
products.description: Administers retirement plans for businesses and individuals nationwide, including plan design, compliance, and recordkeeping, primarily through EPIC Advisors, Inc.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Offers a full array of insurance products, including personal property and casualty, business liability, and commercial insurance, through NBT Insurance Agency, LLC, delivered via agents and digital channels.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Provides online, mobile, and telephone banking, including account management, bill payment, remote deposit capture, eStatements, and loan applications, enabling customers to access banking services electronically.

products.name: Epigenetic Regulation Therapies for Neurological Diseases
products.description: Gene therapies using zinc finger epigenetic regulators (ZFRs) delivered via engineered AAV capsids to modulate gene expression in neurological diseases. These therapies are developed through in-house research and delivered as one-time infusions, requiring advanced manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Engineered AAV Capsid Delivery Platform (STAC-BBB and Variants)
products.description: Proprietary engineered adeno-associated virus (AAV) capsids, such as STAC-BBB, designed for efficient delivery of gene therapies to the central nervous system. These capsids are licensed to external partners and used in both internal and partnered therapeutic programs.

products.name: Gene Therapy for Fabry Disease (Isaralgagene Civaparvovec / ST-920)
products.description: A liver-directed gene therapy using an AAV2/6 vector encoding human α-Gal A, delivered as a one-time intravenous infusion to treat Fabry disease. Requires cGMP manufacturing and regulatory approval for commercialization.

products.name: Gene Therapy for Hemophilia A (Giroctocogene Fitelparvovec / SB-525)
products.description: A gene therapy product delivered as a single intravenous infusion to treat moderately severe to severe hemophilia A by enabling endogenous FVIII expression. Developed using AAV vector technology and subject to clinical and regulatory processes.

products.name: Genome Editing Platform (Zinc Finger Proteins and Modular Integrase / MINT)
products.description: A platform technology for genome editing using engineered zinc finger proteins and modular integrase (MINT) to enable targeted gene modification and integration. This platform is licensed for therapeutic and non-therapeutic applications, including agriculture and research reagents.

products.name: Partnered Genomic Medicine Programs (Collaborative Neurology and Rare Disease Therapies)
products.description: Development and licensing of preclinical and clinical-stage genomic medicine product candidates for various neurological and rare diseases (e.g., tauopathies, ALS, Huntington’s disease) in collaboration with biopharmaceutical partners. These programs leverage Sangamo’s technology platforms and are delivered through licensing and co-development agreements.

products.name: Non-Therapeutic Genome Engineering Solutions (Agriculture, Research Reagents, Transgenic Animals)
products.description: Licensing of genome engineering technologies for non-therapeutic applications, including plant agriculture, research reagents, production of transgenic animals, and cell-line engineering. Delivered through partnerships with companies in agriculture and research sectors.

products.name: Smart Beds and Mattresses
products.description: Digitally-enabled mattresses with adjustable firmness, pressure-relieving support, temperature balancing, and embedded sensors that collect sleep and biosignal data. Manufactured in company facilities and delivered directly to customers, these beds integrate physical comfort with a digital sleep wellness platform.

products.name: Smart Adjustable Bases
products.description: A line of FlexFit® smart adjustable bases that integrate with Sleep Number smart beds, offering features such as head and foot adjustability, Partner Snore™ technology, foot warming, and under-bed lighting. These are manufactured and delivered as part of the smart bed ecosystem.

products.name: Bedding and Sleep Accessories
products.description: A collection of bedding products and upholstered furniture, including pillows, sheets, and accessories designed to improve sleep comfort and quality. These products are manufactured or sourced and sold alongside beds and bases to enhance the sleep environment.

products.name: Sleep Wellness Platform and App
products.description: A digital platform and mobile app that provides personalized sleep insights, nightly SleepIQ® scores, and HealthIQ® reports based on data collected from smart beds. Delivered digitally, it enables users to monitor and improve sleep health and can share reports with health professionals.
